original_target_row.primary_outcome: Change from baseline in self-reported mean weekly pain intensity over 24 weeks
original_target_row.primary_outcome_source: Methods: The primary outcome was the efficacy of botulinum toxin A versus placebo, measured as the change from baseline in self-reported mean weekly pain intensity over the course of 24 weeks from the first administration.
original_target_row.anchor_as_printed: Botulinum toxin A reduced pain intensity over 24 weeks compared with placebo (adjusted effect estimate -0.77, 95% CI -0.95 to -0.59; p<0.0001)
original_target_row.notes: the meta labelled 50% pain reduction (a secondary); Lancet Neurol PDF saved by Zaid, appendix by curl

candidate_examples.original_audit_reason: Continuous mean pain intensity/change differs from binary >=50% pain-response estimand; shared pain wording does not establish result equivalence.
candidate_examples.rationale: 50%responder humanoutcome versus longitudinalmeanpain currenttarget. Separateversioned responder-result diagnostic potentially retains useful human evidence; no label transfer tomeanpain.
